items.title: File objection (Einspruch) against the fine notice
items.quote: Die Frist für den Einspruch beträgt zwei Wochen ab Zustellung; einzulegen ist er schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Kreisverwaltung Musterweiler – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: Formal service (Zustellungsurkunde) noted on the envelope as 17.04.2025 (Thursday); the postal 3-day fiction does not apply to formal service. Period starts the day after service (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 50 OWiG/§ 43 StPO): 18.04.2025. Two weeks end on the same weekday as the service day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Thursday 01.05.2025. That is Labour Day, a public holiday in Rheinland-Pfalz, so the period ends on the next working day (§ 193 BGB, § 43 Abs. 2 StPO): Friday 02.05.2025.

items.title: Pay fine, fee and costs (only if no objection is filed)
items.quote: Fälligkeit des Gesamtbetrags: zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft.
items.computation: Without an objection the notice becomes final when the objection period ends on 02.05.2025 (Friday). Two weeks after that: 16.05.2025 (Friday), not a weekend or holiday. If the Rechtskraft date is counted as 03.05.2025, the date would be 17.05 (Saturday), which moves to 19.05.2025. I use the earliest plausible date. The amount is 100.00 fine + 25.00 fee + 3.50 service costs = 128.50.

warnings: The payment due date depends on when the notice becomes final (Rechtskraft), which the letter does not state. It is calculated here assuming no objection is filed; the Bußgeldstelle may confirm a different date, so check any payment reminder.
